Summarize the size of the local cache

txs_cache_size.Rd

Summarize the size of the local cache

Usage

txs_cache_size(
  source = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  level = NULL,
  data_type = NULL,
  dataset = NULL,
  older_than = NULL,
  by = NULL
)

Arguments

source, year, level, data_type, dataset

Optional filters, same semantics as txs_cache_delete().

older_than

Optional cutoff: a Date/POSIXct, or a single number of days. When given, only files retrieved before the cutoff are counted; useful for previewing what txs_cache_delete(older_than = ) would remove.

by

NULL, or one or more of "source", "year", "level", "data_type", "dataset". When given, returns one row per group (entries missing that field are grouped under NA, not dropped).

Value

A tibble with n_files, size_bytes, and a human-readable size column, plus the grouping column(s) if by is given.

Examples

txs_cache_size()
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   n_files size_bytes size  
#>     <int>      <dbl> <chr> 
#> 1     184  412043793 412 MB
